description: This file defines a NestJS controller class 'SlotsController_2024_04_15' for managing slot reservations, deletions, and retrieval of available slots in a scheduling application. It includes endpoints for reserving a slot, deleting a selected slot, and fetching available slots with support for different slot formats and error handling.

classes.name: SlotsController_2024_04_15
classes.description: NestJS controller handling slot reservation, deletion, and availability retrieval endpoints.

methods.name: reserveSlot
methods.description: Handles POST request to reserve a slot, returns UID of the reserved slot.

methods.name: deleteSelectedSlot
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a reserved slot by UID.

methods.name: getAvailableSlots
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch available slots, with support for different formats and error handling.
